::: {.reading-block .llm-summary}
## LLM-generated summary

Sheldon Axler's *Linear Algebra Done Right* is a proof-based course on finite-dimensional vector spaces that postpones determinants and foregrounds linear maps, eigenvalues, inner-product spaces, and operators. It is written to replace the matrix-calculation-first path with conceptual understanding suitable as a second course in linear algebra. The book is terse, exercise-driven, and aimed at mathematics students rather than engineers looking for row-reduction drills.
:::
